prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Hassium (하슘) itself — the sovereign of the Hassium Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Both hands are ordinary human hands and hold nothing.

1. STYLE
A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance.
Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described below.

2. CHARACTER
Age: late twenties — a graceful grown-up face with soft, smooth contours; no wrinkles, folds or under-eye bags.
Face — her own: a regal, imperious haughtiness; porcelain-pale skin; refined face with a clean, softly tapered outline; medium-sized eyes — feline cat eyes, outer eye corners slightly lifted; gracefully arched brows; slim, delicate nose with a refined bridge; full heart-shaped lips; forest-green eyes; a soft rose-red tint on the lips.
Body and hair: tall and statuesque with long legs and a full, curvaceous figure — full bust and hips, narrow waist build; a pixie cut with side-swept bangs; deep beech-forest green hair with red-sandstone lowlights and warm autumn-gold glints like turning beech leaves.
Hair: her hair is worn exactly as described above — loose, long or cut as named; do not pin it up into a bun or tuck it under goggles or a hat unless the hair above is an updo.
Expression: a relaxed, unforced face, lips gently closed.
Her element, carried in her design: hassium: a heavy synthetic metal below osmium, first made in 1984 by striking lead with iron ions in a research city, and named in Latin for the forested hill state around it, a land of deep beech and oak woods, red sandstone castles on wooded ridges and old fairy tales gathered there by two brothers; in 2001 a few atoms were turned into a volatile oxide gas just as osmium is, proving it a true heavier osmium, and one of its forms sits on a doubly magic shelf of unusual stability.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — STEAMPUNK
Costume: late-Victorian industrial dress — a high-necked blouse with a waistcoat or a tailored tail coat, leather gloves, a work apron or utility belt with brass fittings, goggles hung at the neck or a small instrument as ornament; below, a short bustle skirt and laced boots; the traits above as colour accents. No crown unless the opening line says she wears one; steam, pipes and gauges in the scene.
Silhouette: a short naval frock coat with gold braid, a captain's cap and a sash catching the wind — a seafarer's shape. Only the overall shape is fixed; design the details freely in the element's materials and palette. This silhouette overrides the overall shape of the costume above.
Colours: deep beech-forest green, red sandstone, osmium blue-grey metal, autumn beech gold.
Exposure (bold): her outfit opens to show skin — the neckline opened down to the sternum with natural cleavage, bare forearms, and bare legs above the boots or through a high slit where the silhouette allows; pieces stay symmetrical. Nothing slipped off. Intimate areas covered; no corset; keep the costume above, material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: around 1914, a great new reservoir lake in a forested hill state: a colossal stone dam just completed, an old castle on the wooded ridge above, a white lake steamer at its pier, and the church spire of a drowned village just breaking the water.
This card: on the deck of a white lake steamer.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: bright warm sunlight with soft sky light bounced from white clouds.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Hs) and atomic number (108) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face, plastic 3D-render finish, armor plates, cape, modern plastic, sci-fi.
